notes: *neither … nor* placed on לֹא and the waw per rule 14 (present negative takes the opening correlative); both גַּם unrepresented. Competing reading gives *neither*/*nor* to the גַּם … וְגַם pair.
הָיָה → *required* as the verb standing where the copula stands, נָחוּץ → *haste*; competing reading leaves הָיָה unrepresented with *required haste* whole on נָחוּץ.
